name: Honeycomb
summary: Honeycomb prices by event volume, not by host or seat. The free plan covers 20 million events and 100 million metric data points a month. Pro starts at $150 a month for 50 million events and scales to 750 million, with unlimited seats and SSO included.

facts.text: Triggers notify a team when query results cross a threshold, through methods such as Slack, PagerDuty or email.
Application and system metrics can be sent to Honeycomb and queried alongside traces and logs.
The pricing page lists unlimited seats and gives the Free plan 2 triggers, the Pro plan 100 triggers and 2 SLOs.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 20 million events and 100 million metric data points a month, 2 triggers

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Starting price for 50 million events, scaling to 750 million events and 3.75 billion metric data points a month. 100 triggers and 2 SLOs. Monthly or annual billing

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom quote, with a base allowance of 10 billion events a year

hiddenCosts: The page lists telemetry collection starting at $0.10 per GB in addition to plan prices.
The page does not state data retention periods or what happens above the event limit.
